Title: Some users are unable to see model selection options in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat

User impact: Users are unable to see model selection options in Copilot chat.

More info: Affected users may not see GPT, Claude, or other available models within the model selection options in Copilot chat.

Current status: We've received reports indicating an issue with model selection options in Copilot Chat. We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the root cause and determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and some users attempting to access GPT, Claude, or other model selection options in Copilot chat are impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to see model selection options in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat

User impact: Users may be unable to see model selection options in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat.

More info: Affected users may not see GPT, Claude, or other available models within the model selection options in Copilot chat.
 
Current status: We've identified a component responsible for producing the model selection options in Copilot chat was not functioning correctly. To mitigate impact, we've developed a fix which is currently being deployed to the affected infrastructure and we're monitoring this process closely to ensure it delivers the expected resolution.
 
Scope of impact: Some users attempting to access GPT, Claude, or other model selection options in Copilot chat may be impacted. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.
 
Next update by: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 11:00 AM UTC

We've completed deploying the fix to the affected infrastructure, and we've verified in our internal environment that the model selection options have been restored within Copilot chat. We're now contacting affected customers directly to ensure the fix has produced the expected resolution.

This quick update is designed to give the latest information on this issue.

Title: Some users were unable to see model selection options in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat

User impact: Users were unable to see model selection options in Microsoft 365 Copilot chat.

More info: Affected users were unable to see GPT, Claude, or other available models within the model selection options in Copilot chat.
 
Final status: We’ve verified through service telemetry and previously impacted users that the issue is now resolved.
 
Scope of impact: Some users attempting to access GPT, Claude, or other model selection options in Copilot chat were impacted. 

Start time: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 3:34 AM UTC

Preliminary root cause: A recent change resulted in the component responsible for producing the model selection options in Copilot chat to not function correctly.
 
Next steps:
- We're analyzing service telemetry on the affected component to help prevent this problem from happening again.
 
We’ll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
